paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Distribution of articles across media outlets
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across a range of media outlets. The chart contains twelve distinct slices, representing twelve different news sources. The largest slice, colored blue, represents “Breitbart” with approximately 14%, followed by “Shareblue” at approximately 13% and “Fox News” at approximately 13%. The next largest slice, colored dark green, depicts “Drudge Report” with approximately 8%, and “NPR” is represented by an 8% slice colored purple. Remaining slices, colored in shades of pink, yellow, gray, and brown, represent “The Daily Caller,” “The Huffington Post”, “CNN,” “The Guardian,” “BBC,” “Vox,” “RT,” “Daily Kos,” “National Review,” “Daily Mail State,” and “Other,” with approximate proportions of 6%, 5%, 4%, 3%, 3%, 3%, 3%, 3%, 3%, 3%, and 3% respectively.  The chart includes percentage labels within each slice, and all slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of area.
